verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents control over session lifetime and refresh tokens, a configurable JWT expiry limit, and refresh token rotation that detects reuse of revoked refresh tokens. The evidence never shows a documented way to immediately revoke a compromised session server-side, including its live access token. Missing for 10: an explicit admin or server-side session revocation API, evidence that revocation takes effect immediately rather than waiting for access token expiry, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage session lifecycle — expiry, refresh, and immediate server-side revocation of a compromised session

citations.quote: Control session lifetime, refresh tokens, and multi-device sign-in behavior.
The expiry of an access token can be set in the "JWT expiry limit" field in [your project's auth settings]
If refresh token rotation is enabled, auth will automatically detect malicious attempts to reuse a revoked refresh token.
